Founded by Alina Denysova, a nail technician and instructor with 17 years in the industry, Shape Nail Studio built its 5.0 rating one appointment at a time.

parrafo_1.es: Shape Nail Studio está liderado por Alina Denysova, técnica e instructora de uñas con 17 años de experiencia y fundadora de dos salones, uno en Nueva York y este en Hallandale. Junto a ella, Ksenia aporta 10 años de experiencia en manicura de hardware y nail art, y Anastasia completa el equipo.
parrafo_1.en: Shape Nail Studio is led by Alina Denysova, a nail technician and instructor with 17 years of experience and founder of two salons, one in New York and this one in Hallandale. Alongside her, Ksenia brings 10 years of hardware manicure and nail art expertise, and Anastasia rounds out the team.
